decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or its ancillary or curtilage structures, or the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and restoration hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structures as specifically shown on the approved drawings.

Condition : 4 - Prior to the commencement of the development a detailed description of the steps and works to be taken and carried out in relation to the dismantling and restoration of the memorial and the cleaning of the stonework , shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing and the development shall thereafter be undertaken in accordance with the approved scheme.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until a sample of the Portland Cement to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 6 - Upon completion of the works hereby approved, any damage caused to the ground by the works shall be made good within a month, in accordance with a scheme submitted to, and approved in writing, by the local planning authority.
Condition : 7 - The memorial shall be removed, stored and re-erected under the supervision of a specialist contractor approved in writing by the local planning authority
description: Relocation of first world war memorial currently located in front of St. Lawrence's Church, High Street, Brentford to the garden of Rememberance Brentford Library
